blocks.text: South Korean actors Ahn Bo-hyun and Claudia Kim are set to visit the Philippines on Dec. 5 for a special screening of their upcoming historical action-adventure series, “Sacred Jewel.” The actors will attend the premiere event, which will include a screening of the series’ first episode at Shangri-La Red Carpet Cinemas in Manila. Select invited guests, including members of the media, content creators and fans, will have the opportunity to meet the lead stars and watch the episode ahead of the series’ premiere.
